The current report forms are in [[business-insights.reports]], and the area hub is [[business-insights.legacy]].

system-reports.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, System Generated Reports are generated monthly: an Applications Report and a Workplaces Report, both AI-powered assessments.

quotes: Go to Analytics > Reports > System Generated Reports.
The reports are generated on a monthly basis.
Applications Report: Assessment of your application portfolio powered by AI
Workplaces Report: Assessment of your workplaces powered by AI

workplace-report-delivery.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Scheduled workplace reports have a Time Period of Daily, Weekly or Monthly and an email schedule of Daily, Weekly on Mondays or Monthly on First Monday.

quotes: Select Daily, Weekly, or Monthly as the time period for the workplace attendance report.
Select the day on which you want to schedule the report for email distribution from Daily, Weekly on Mondays, or Monthly on First Monday.

workplace-report-aggregation.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, A workplace report's Data Aggregated value is Daily, Weekly or Monthly and must be less than or equal to the When - Time Period value.

quotes: Data Aggregated: Select the data aggregation time period for the report from Daily, Weekly, or Monthly. You must select the time period less than or equal to the value selected in the When - Time Period field.

workplace-report-where.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Workplace report location options are All Offices (excluding remote users), Select Offices, All Offices and Remote Users, and Remote Users, where users with zero office visits are categorized as remote users.

quotes: All Offices: Select this option to include all the offices in the report except the remote users. Users with zero office visits are categorized under remote users.
Select Offices: Select this option to choose the offices for which you want to generate the report.
All Offices and Remote Users: Select this option to include all the offices and remote users in the report.
Remote Users: Select this option to generate the report for all remote users.

workplace-report-who-organize.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, A workplace report includes All Users, Users by Department or Users by Division, and when the data is organized by Office the report shows Visits (the number of visits on that date), and when it is organized by User it shows Timespan (the time spent in the office during the visit).

quotes: Office: Select this option to organize the data in the report based on the office. The report displays information in the following format:
User: Select this option to organize the data in the report based on individual users and the time spent in the office. The report displays information in the following format:
Users by Division: Select this option and select the divisions that you want to include in the report from the drop-down menu that appears.
Visits: The number of visits on that date.
Timespan: The time spent in the office during the visit.
All Users: Select this option to include all the users in your organization.
Users by Department: Select this option and select the departments that you want to include in the report from the drop-down menu that appears.

application-report-types.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, An application report is an Inactivity Period or Activity Period report with a cadence of 1 day, 30 days, 60 days or 90 days, scheduled Daily, Weekly, Monthly or Quarterly.

quotes: Cadence: Select the time frame for which you want to generate the report from 1 day, 30 days, 60 days, or 90 days.
Select the report generation and delivery schedule from Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or Quarterly.
Inactivity Period: Select this option to generate the inactivity report for the application.
Activity Period: Select this option to generate the activity report for the application.

application-report-list-schedule.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The Application Reports list describes Delivery Schedule as Weekly, Monthly or Quarterly.

quotes: Delivery Schedule: The frequency of the report generation and delivery (Weekly, Monthly, or Quarterly).

application-report-subset.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, An application report that includes a subset of users can select up to 128 users and departments.

quotes: Subset: Select the users, departments, or both that you want included in the report. You can select up to 128 users and departments.

application-report-delivery-method.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Application reports can be delivered by Workflow Automation, email or both, and the Workflow Automation integration can be tested by entering recipient emails and clicking Submit Test.

quotes: You can select one or both of the following options:
To test the Workflow Automation integration, enter the recipients' email addresses and click Submit Test. The recipients receive a test email confirming successful integration.
Workflow Automation: Select this option to integrate the report with Workflow Automation.
Email: Select this option and enter the email addresses of the recipients that receive the report via email.

application-report-exclusions.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, An application report can exclude users via the Exclusion List and/or a Custom list; modifying the exclusion list affects every scheduled report that applies it, so Zscaler recommends Custom for report-specific exclusions.

quotes: Any modification to the exclusion list affects all the scheduled reports where Exclusion List is applied. To exclude report-specific users, Zscaler recommends enabling the Custom option and selecting users and departments.

exclusion-limit.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Multiple exclusions can be added but only up to 8 can be enabled at any time, and an enabled exclusion is associated only with scheduled reports whose applications match the exclusion's.

quotes: You can add multiple exclusions, however you can only enable up to 8 exclusions at any time.
The enabled exclusions must also match the applications configured in the scheduled reports for the exclusion to be associated with the reports.

exclusion-change-effect.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, When an exclusion is disabled, modified or enabled, scheduled reports that use the exclusion list are generated with the latest list, and the Exclusion List shows per exclusion the number of reports it is associated with.

quotes: Whenever you disable, modify, or enable an exclusion, the existing scheduled reports that use the exclusion list are generated considering the latest exclusion list.
Reports: The number of reports the exclusion is associated with.

exclusion-disable.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Disabling an exclusion disassociates it from all scheduled reports using the exclusion list, and only enabled exclusions are associated with scheduled reports.

quotes: Disabling an exclusion disassociates it from all the scheduled reports using the exclusion list. Only enabled exclusions are associated with scheduled reports at any time.

enable-disable-report.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Disabling a scheduled report stops report generation and distribution, and enabling it resumes them.

quotes: Disabling a scheduled report stops report generation and distribution to the recipients and vice versa when you enable a report.

data-explorer-options.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, A Data Explorer view groups by options including Department, Division, Geolocation and Work Mode, and the Aggregation Type function is not available for daily aggregation.

quotes: - Department
- Division
- Work Mode
- Geolocation
This option is not available for daily aggregation.
c. Aggregation Type
Select the data aggregation function:

data-explorer-metrics.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The Data Explorer Metrics section lists Bytes, Visits, Occupancy and Attendance, and filters can narrow a view by Division, Department and Work Mode.

quotes: In the Metrics section, select the metrics for the view. You can select multiple metrics:
narrow the results of your view for a specific Division, Department, and Work Mode.
- Bytes - Visits - Occupancy - Attendance

data-explorer-time-period.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The Data Explorer Time Period section offers Last 7 days, Week, Month or 3 Months.

quotes: In the Time Period section, select an option to process the data for the Last 7 days, Week, Month, or 3 Months.

data-explorer-schedule-condition.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Data Explorer reports can be scheduled only when the time period selected is Last Day, Last Week or Last Month.

quotes: You can schedule Data Explorer reports only when the time period selected is Last Day, Last Week, or Last Month.

data-explorer-export.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Data Explorer results can be exported as a detailed report (Export Full Report) or a CSV file (Export).

quotes: Click Export Full Report to download a detailed report.
Click Export to download the data as a CSV file.

data-explorer-delivery.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, A scheduled Data Explorer report is delivered Daily or Weekly to comma-separated email recipients.

quotes: Deliver: Select the report generation frequency (i.e., Daily or Weekly).
Use a comma to separate multiple email addresses.

data-explorer-reports-page.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The Data Explorer Reports page lists Name, Summary, Scheduled (active or not), Next Run, Last Updated and Last Updated By (the email address of the last editor).

quotes: Scheduled: Indicates whether the report is active or not.
Last Updated By: The email address of the user who last modified the scheduled report.
Name: The name of the scheduled report.
Summary: A brief summary of the report. This is autogenerated based on the scheduled report.
Next Run: The date when the next report is scheduled to be generated.
Last Updated: The date when the scheduled report was last modified.

application-report-schedule-values.summary: The scheduling article offers Daily among the application report delivery schedules, while the Application Reports list describes Delivery Schedule without Daily.

quotes: When - Delivery Schedule: Select the report generation and delivery schedule from Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or Quarterly.

positions.says: The delivery schedule is selected from Daily, Weekly, Monthly or Quarterly.

quotes: Delivery Schedule: The frequency of the report generation and delivery (Weekly, Monthly, or Quarterly).

positions.says: The Delivery Schedule column is described as Weekly, Monthly or Quarterly.

application-report-schedule-values.impact: Whether an application report can be scheduled Daily is stated differently by the scheduling and list articles.

data-explorer-schedulable-periods.summary: The Data Explorer time periods offered in a view do not match the periods that the schedule condition names.

quotes: In the Time Period section, select an option to process the data for the Last 7 days, Week, Month, or 3 Months.

positions.says: The Time Period section offers Last 7 days, Week, Month or 3 Months.

quotes: You can schedule Data Explorer reports only when the time period selected is Last Day, Last Week, or Last Month.

positions.says: Scheduling requires a time period of Last Day, Last Week or Last Month.

data-explorer-schedulable-periods.impact: The periods that allow scheduling (Last Day, Last Week, Last Month) are not among the periods the Time Period section lists, so which option permits scheduling is not stated.
